strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: programme wa van sales ne basumbishi ba mu njila
strings.tierB.home.description: Programme bua bena kabanya bintu: fakitire ne resi ku telefone, stock wa mashinyi, makuta, njila ne makumbula. Udi wenza kakuyi internet, utuma pashishe.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Lombola basumbishi bebe kubangila ku dikumbula dia kumpala too ne ku makuta masangisha a ndekelu
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales udi programme wa cloud bua ba entreprises ya kabanya bintu ne ya ba grossistes idi ne basumbishi ba mu njila (commerciaux terrain). Basumbishi badi bafunda ne bapatula mu imprimante fakitire ne resi ku telefone, batangila stock udi mu mashinyi ne bafunda makumbula; balombodi badi bamona diakamue bintu bisumbisha, makuta masangisha ne mabanza a basumbi.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Fakitire ku telefone wa musumbishi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Musumbishi udi ufunda fakitire ku tshibi tshia musumbi, ne uyipatula mu imprimante thermique ya Bluetooth kumpala kua kupatuka mu butiki.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Kuangata makuta ne mabanza a basumbi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Difuta dionso didi dipeta resi ne nomba, disuikakane ne fakitire idi difuta, ne dibanza dia musumbi ne relevé wa compte wende bidi bishintuluka diakamue.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Stock udi musumbishi wambula mu mashinyi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Stock wa mashinyi yonso badi bamulonda tshintu ne tshintu: biteka mu mashinyi, bisumbisha, bipingaja ne bishala, bua dishilangana dimueneke mu dituku adi dine.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Njila ne makumbula a basumbi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Dikumbula dionso badi badifunda ne muaba, dîba ne bifoto, ne njila wa musumbishi yonso udi umueneka pa karte bua mfumu.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Udi wenza kakuyi internet
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Basumbishi badi batungunuka ne kusumbisha nansha kakuyi réseau. Mikanda idi ishala mu telefone, ne padi internet upingana idi iya nkayayi ku serveur; mukanda wonso udi ufika musangu umue nkayawu.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Tableau de bord wa web bua balombodi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Bintu bisumbisha, makuta masangisha, bipingaja, stock ne mudimu wa basumbishi mu muaba umue, ne muntu yonso wa mu entreprise udi ne tshitupa tshiende ne bukokeshi buende.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Tuambila mushindu udi usumbisha
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Lomba devis anyi tshisangilu. Tudi tutangila basumbishi bebe, njila yebe, bintu biebe ne biudi ukengela bua fakitire.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Longolola entreprise webe
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Sakidila bintu, mishinga yabi, basumbi ne basumbishi, ne mu ba paramètres sungula makuta ne taxe bia ditunga diebe.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Tuma basumbishi mu njila
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Basumbishi badi bateka application ku Android anyi iPhone, bawuja mashinyi ne babanga kusumbisha, kupatula fakitire ne kuangata makuta.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Londa dituku padi dienda
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Tableau de bord wa web udi uleja bintu bisumbisha, makuta masangisha, stock wa mashinyi ne makumbula, basumbishi bakidi mu njila.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales udi programme wa cloud wa kulombola basumbishi ba mu njila mu ba entreprises ya kabanya bintu ne ya ba grossistes. Udi ne van sales (kusumbisha bintu mu mashinyi), route sales (kusumbisha mu njila idi imanyike), pre-sales (kuangata ba commandes kumpala) ne DSD (kuambula bintu tshiakane ku butiki). Basumbishi badi bafunda fakitire, bayipatula mu imprimante, baangata makuta ne bafunda makumbula ku telefone; balombodi badi balonda bintu bisumbisha, makuta masangisha, stock wa mashinyi ne mabanza a basumbi pa tableau de bord wa web.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Eyowa. Application wa musumbishi udi utungunuka ne kuenza kakuyi internet: musumbishi udi ufunda ne upatula fakitire ne resi, ufunda makumbula ne usakidila basumbi bapiabapia, ne padi internet upingana, bionso bidi biya nkayabi ku serveur, tshintu tshionso musangu umue nkayawu. Kudi bualu bumue bushilangane mu Arabie Saoudite: ba entreprises idi ne disuikakana dia e-invoicing idi ne bua kuikala ne internet pa dîba dia kupatula fakitire anyi fakitire wa bintu bipingaja.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.q: FieldSales udi wenza mu matunga kayi?
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales udi wenza ne ba entreprises ya kabanya bintu mu matunga onso. Entreprise yonso idi isungula makuta ayi ne taxe mu ba paramètres ayi, ne fakitire, resi ne ba rapports bidi bikuata nabi mudimu. FieldSales udi ne biro binene mu Riyadh, Arabie Saoudite, ne dibanga didi dienzeka ku internet, ku bisangilu, WhatsApp ne diambuluisha dia kule.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales udi usuikakana ne ba systèmes ya Mbulamatadi ya e-invoicing?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Tudi tuambuluisha disuikakana dia tshitupa tshibidi ne plateforme Fatoora wa ZATCA. Bualu ebu budi butangila ba entreprises idi mu Arabie Saoudite. Mu matunga makuabu, nansha mu RDC, FieldSales udi upatula fakitire ne makuta ebe ne taxe webe, ne disuikakana ne système wa ditunga wa e-invoicing didi mua kuenzeka pa dilomba, panyima pa kutangila nebe malu adi ditunga adi dilomba. Pambelu pa Arabie Saoudite katuena tulaya ne fakitire neyumvuangane ne malu adi ditunga nansha dimue dilomba to.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: Application wa FieldSales udi mu miakulu kayi?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Interface wa application FieldSales udi anu mu miakulu eyi: Tshiarabu, Tshiangelesa, Tshifalanse, Tshiturki ne Tshishinwa. Interface kena mu Tshiluba to. Basumbishi ne balombodi badi mua kushintulula muakulu wa interface, ne fakitire ipatula mu imprimante idi mua kuikala ne muakulu muibidi ku luseke lua muakulu wa kumpala. Ba pages ya site mu miakulu mikuabu, nansha page eu wa Tshiluba, tudi tuyikudimuna anu bua kumanyisha malu a FieldSales.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.q: Ndi mua kubanga kuenza mudimu ne FieldSales munyi?
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Lomba devis, lomba tshisangilu anyi tufundile ku WhatsApp. Tudi tulonga mudi basumbishi bebe benza mudimu, pashishe tukuambuluisha bua kulongolola bintu, mishinga yabi, basumbi ne basumbishi. Basumbishi badi bateka application ku Android anyi iPhone, ne balombodi badi bakuata mudimu ne tableau de bord mu navigateur yonso. Ba smartphones anu ke bintu bia mudimu biudi ukengela.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Interface wa application FieldSales udi mu miakulu eyi: Tshiarabu, Tshiangelesa, Tshifalanse, Tshiturki ne Tshishinwa. Interface kena mu Tshiluba to. Ba pages mu miakulu mikuabu idi ileja FieldSales anu bua kumanyisha.
strings.tierB.category.title: Programme wa van sales bua bena kabanya bintu | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Programme wa van sales ne route sales: fakitire ipatula ku telefone, stock wa mashinyi tshintu ne tshintu, makuta ne makumbula. Udi wenza kakuyi internet.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Programme wa van sales (kusumbisha bintu mu mashinyi) bua bena kabanya bintu ne ba grossistes
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales udi programme wa van sales bua ba entreprises idi ne basumbishi badi basumbisha bintu mu mashinyi mu njila matuku onso. Musumbishi udi uwuja mashinyi, usumbisha ku butiki yonso, upatula fakitire mu imprimante, uangata makuta ne ufunda bintu bipingaja ne application umue ku telefone. Mfumu udi umona bintu biteka mu mashinyi, bisumbisha, makuta masangisha ne bishala mu mashinyi yonso.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Programme wa van sales ntshinyi?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Programme wa van sales, udi babikila kabidi ne cash van anyi route sales, udi ulombola mushindu wa kusumbisha udi musumbishi wambula bintu mu mashinyi, usumbisha, ufikisha bintu, ufunda fakitire ne uangata makuta mu dikumbula dimue. Udi wangata muaba wa mikanda ya fakitire ya papier ne ba appels ya dilolo. Udi ufunda disumbisha dionso, difuta dionso ne tshintu tshionso tshipingaja bu mukanda, bua kufuanyikija stock ne makuta mu dituku adi dine. Bua mfumu, udi wandamuna nkonko isatu dilolo dionso: musumbishi yonso musumbishe tshinyi, musangishe makuta bungi kayi, ne tshinyi tshikadi tshishala mu mashinyi yonso.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Dituku dimue mu njila
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Dituku didi dibanga ne kuwuja mashinyi kufumina ku depo, ne mukanda. Ku butiki yonso, musumbishi udi usungula musumbi mu application, usakidila bintu ku liste anyi ku barcode, ufunda fakitire ne uyipatula mu imprimante thermique. Difuta badi badifunda ne resi, ne tshintu tshionso tshipingaja badi batshifunda ne bualu buatshi. Dilolo, bintu bishala mu mashinyi badi babipingaja ku depo. Munkatshi mua malu aa, mfumu udi mua kulonda bintu bisumbisha, makuta masangisha ne makumbula a musumbishi yonso pa tableau de bord wa web, kakuyi kubikila muntu ku telefone.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Mmuenza bua miaba idi kayi ne réseau mukole
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Njila ya kabanya bintu idi ipita mu ba sous-sols, mu miaba ya ba usines ne mu misoko idi kayi ne réseau mukole. Application wa musumbishi wa FieldSales udi ulama basumbi, bintu ne mishinga yabi mu telefone, bua musumbishi apete mua kufunda ne kupatula mikanda kakuyi internet. Mukanda wonso udi ne nomba wawu nkayawu wa dishilangana, nunku udi ufika ku serveur musangu umue nkayawu, nansha bobu bapingana kuutuma misangu ya bungi. Ba entreprises ya mu Arabie Saoudite idi ne disuikakana dia e-invoicing idi ne bua kuikala ne internet pa dîba dia kupatula fakitire ne fakitire ya bintu bipingaja. Resi, makumbula ne basumbi bapiabapia bidi bitungunuka ne kuenza kakuyi internet bua bobu.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Kuangata makuta ne stock wa mashinyi
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Makuta adi baambula mu njila adi ne bua kutangidibua bu stock. Makuta onso masangisha adi apeta resi ne nomba udi mua kusuikakana ne fakitire idi afuta, ne dibanza dia musumbi didi dishintuluka diakamue. Stock wa mashinyi badi bamubala tshintu ne tshintu: biteka mu mashinyi, kumbusha bisumbisha, kusakidila bipingaja ne mashintuluka mafunda, bua balombodi bapete mua kumufuanyikija ne dibala dia bulelela kumpala kua musumbishi kupingana ku nzubu. Bintu bipingaja badi mua kubitapulula: bia pa tshibidilu, bionaka anyi bia kushintakaja, ne mfumu ke udi wangata dipangadika bikala bidi bipingana mu stock wa mashinyi udi mua kusumbishibua.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Bua nganyi?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales udi ukumbanyina bena kabanya bintu ne ba grossistes ba bintu bidi bisumbishibua lukasa bu biakudia, bia kunua, bia kusukula ne bia kulama mubidi, ne entreprise yonso idi ne basumbishi badi bakumbula ba butiki mu njila. Udi uambuluisha van sales, ba commandes ya pre-sales ne DSD (kuambula bintu tshiakane ku butiki). Kena ERP mujima to: udi usuikakana ne système webe wa comptabilité anyi ERP ku diambuluisha dia API. Balombodi ke badi bangata dipangadika dia malu adi musumbishi yonso udi mua kuenza, bu mudi kufila remise, kusumbisha muinshi mua mushinga wa liste anyi kusakidila basumbi bapiabapia.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Dishilangana kayi didi pankatshi pa van sales ne pre-sales?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Mu van sales, musumbishi udi wambula bintu, ubifila, ufunda fakitire ne uangata makuta mu dikumbula dimue. Mu pre-sales, musumbishi udi wangata commande, pashishe depo udi uyiambula panyima. FieldSales udi uambuluisha mishindu ibidi eyi, bua entreprise ipete mua kukuata mudimu ne cash van ku miaba mikuabu ne kuangata ba commandes ku miaba mikuabu. Mu mishindu ibidi eyi, fakitire, makuta masangisha ne mabanza a basumbi bidi mu système umue, ne balombodi badi babimona pamue mu ba rapports.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Ndi mua kufuanyikija stock wa mashinyi dilolo munyi?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales udi uleja, bua tshintu tshionso mu mashinyi yonso, bungi bua biteka, bisumbisha, bipingaja ne bishala. Fuanyikija bungi bua bishala ne dibala dia bulelela, funda dishilangana bu dishintuluka difunda, pashishe pingaja bishala bionso ku depo musangu umue. Mashinyi udi ubanga dituku dilonda ne compte mukezuke udi umanyike.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Musumbishi wa van sales udi ukengela bintu kayi?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Smartphone, Android anyi iPhone. Imprimante thermique ya Bluetooth idi ya kusungula, kadi idi iambuluisha musumbishi bua kufila kudi musumbi fakitire anyi resi ipatula mu imprimante. FieldSales kena usumbisha bintu bia mudimu to ne kena ulomba marque kampanda wa imprimante to. Balombodi badi bakuata mudimu ne tableau de bord mu navigateur wa ordinateur anyi wa telefone yonso.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales udi mua kusuikakana ne système wetu wa comptabilité?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Eyowa. FieldSales udi ufila API udi ufila njila kudi système webe wa comptabilité anyi ERP bua kushintakaja ne plateforme basumbi, bintu, fakitire, resi ne ba mouvements ya stock. Équipe webe anyi intégrateur webe udi wenza disuikakana edi ne mikanda idi ileja API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales mu matunga: makuta, taxe ne e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales udi wenza ne bena kabanya bintu mu matunga onso. Tangila makuta, taxe ne e-invoicing wa ditunga dionso mu tableau umue.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales udi wenza ne ba entreprises ya kabanya bintu mu matunga onso. Entreprise yonso idi isungula ditunga diayi, makuta ne taxe mu ba paramètres ayi, ne fakitire, resi ne ba rapports bidi bilonda malu aa. Disuikakana ne e-invoicing wa Mbulamatadi didi dienza anu mu Arabie Saoudite. Mu matunga makuabu onso didi mua kuenzeka pa dilomba. Tableau udi muinshi emu udi uleja, bua ditunga dionso, makuta adi bakuata nawu mudimu, taxe wa pa tshibidilu pa disumbisha anyi TVA, ne bikala disuikakana ne e-invoicing wa Mbulamatadi didi dienza anyi didi mua kuenzeka pa dilomba.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Tudi tuambuluisha disuikakana dia tshitupa tshibidi ne plateforme Fatoora wa ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Makuta ne taxe bidi entreprise yonso isungula mu ba paramètres ayi nkayayi. Ba taxes idi mu tableau eu mmalu anu a kulombola nawu, ne adi mua kushintuluka; tangila mikenji ya lelu ne conseiller webe wa taxe. Tiret (—) udi uleja ne taxe wa pa tshibidilu kena mufunda bua ditunga adi to.
strings.tierB.about.title: Malu a FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales udi wenza programmes ya cloud bua ba entreprises ya kabanya bintu idi ne basumbishi ba mu njila. Wakabanga mu 2026 mu Riyadh, Arabie Saoudite.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (dîna mu Tshiarabu: فيلد سيلز) udi programme wa cloud bua ba entreprises ya kabanya bintu ne ya ba grossistes idi ne basumbishi ba mu njila. FieldSales wakabanga mu 2026 ne udi ne biro binene mu Riyadh, Arabie Saoudite. Udi wenza ne ba entreprises mu matunga onso, ne makuta ne taxe wa ditunga dionso badi babiteka mu ba paramètres ya entreprise nkayayi. Basumbi betu mba entreprises idi isumbisha ne iambula bintu ku diambuluisha dia basumbishi badi mu njila: bena kabanya bintu, ba grossistes ne ba usines idi ne mashinyi ayi a kusumbisha.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Tudi tuenza système umue usuikakane bua mudimu mujima wa mu njila: fakitire ipatula mu imprimante kufumina ku telefone wa musumbishi, resi ne mabanza a basumbi, stock udi musumbishi wambula mu mashinyi, njila ne makumbula ne muaba ne bifoto, ne tableau de bord wa web bua balombodi. Application wa musumbishi udi wenza ku Android ne iPhone ne udi utungunuka ne kuenza kakuyi internet, pashishe udi utuma mikanda padi internet upingana. Ba entreprises idi mua kusuika FieldSales ne système ayi wa comptabilité anyi ERP ku diambuluisha dia API, bua malu a mu njila kaadi ne bua kufundibua misangu ibidi to.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Tudi tuleja programme bu mudiye. Tudi tuambuluisha disuikakana dia tshitupa tshibidi ne plateforme Fatoora wa ZATCA. Disuikakana ne ba systèmes ya Mbulamatadi mu matunga makuabu didi mua kuenzeka pa dilomba. Interface wa application udi mu miakulu eyi: Tshiarabu, Tshiangelesa, Tshifalanse, Tshiturki ne Tshishinwa. Interface kena mu Tshiluba to. Bua kuyikila netu, lomba devis, lomba tshisangilu anyi tufundile ku WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Yikila ne FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Yikila ne équipe wa FieldSales: lomba devis, lomba tshisangilu anyi yikila netu ku WhatsApp bua programme wa van sales ne wa basumbishi.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Tuambila mudi basumbishi bebe basumbisha lelu ne tshiudi musue kushintulula. Lomba devis, lomba tshisangilu anyi tufundile ku WhatsApp, ne muntu umue wa mu équipe wetu neakuandamune. Bua diambuluisha, basumbi betu badiku badi mua kukuata mudimu ne njila eyi imue. Bidi bituambuluisha bikala utuambila ditunga diebe, bungi bua basumbishi bebe, ne bikala basumbisha mu mashinyi, baangata ba commandes, anyi bionso bibidi.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Lomba tshisangilu ku internet ne équipe wetu. Netukuleje dituku dia musumbishi mu application ne tableau de bord wa mfumu, ne bileshilu bidi pabuipi ne bintu biebe ne njila yebe, ne netuandamune nkonko yebe ya malu a kubanga.
